hero.title: Financial tracking, designed for clarity.
hero.description: Fintrack helps you track income, expenses, and financial patterns with structured records and clear insights. Built for people who value control over their financial data.

trust.privacy_desc: Your financial data stays yours. No third-party tracking.
trust.security_desc: Bank-grade encryption and secure data storage practices.
trust.reliability_desc: Consistent performance and accurate financial tracking.

features.title: Core Capabilities
features.subtitle: Essential ways for managing your financial data with precision and clarity.
features.transaction_desc: Maintain organized financial records with categorized income and expenses. Clear data structure for easy reference.
features.analytics_desc: Understand where your money goes with visual breakdowns and category-based analytics. Identify trends over time.
features.receipt_desc: Upload receipts and extract transaction details automatically. Save time on manual data entry.
features.account_desc: Sign up in seconds with email or use Google, GitHub, or Microsoft. Set your preferred currency and start tracking.

how_it_works.title: How Fintrack Works
how_it_works.subtitle: Start tracking your finances in three straightforward steps.
how_it_works.step1_desc: Sign up in seconds. Set your preferred currency and financial tracking preferences.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Add income and expenses manually or scan receipts. Categorize transactions for organized records.
how_it_works.step3_desc: View spending breakdowns, track patterns, and generate reports. Make informed financial decisions.

philosophy.title: Product Philosophy
philosophy.subtitle: FinTrak is built on principles that prioritize your needs and respect your time.
philosophy.principle1_desc: We focus on presenting your financial data in a way that's easy to understand. No confusing jargon or overwhelming interfaces.
philosophy.principle2_desc: Our analytics show you what matters: spending patterns, category breakdowns, and trends that help you make decisions.
philosophy.principle3_desc: You decide how to categorize and track your finances. FinTrak supports your workflow, not the other way around.

cta.title: Start Tracking Your Finances Today
cta.description: Join others who have taken control of their financial data with Fintrack.

footer.tagline: Financial tracking designed for clarity and control.
